verdict.rationale: Consensus offers some scope controls like filters (study type, year, discipline), Deep Searches for more comprehensive lit reviews, and a research agent that chains multiple retrieval steps, which give users some ability to set scope before a run. However, there is no evidence of adjusting depth/effort or steering a run while it executes (mid-run interaction), nor of configurable parameters like number of sources or iteration depth. missing for 10: mid-execution steering, explicit depth/effort controls, evidence of interactive adjustment during a run.
